content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online without relying on payment platforms like PayPal or Stripe opens up a world of possibilities for digital creators. By utilizing crypto payments, you can ensure that you keep more of your hard-earned revenue. For instance, while Gumroad takes a substantial 10% cut on each sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference is significant: if you make 100 sales a month at $97 each, using NOWPayments allows you to retain an additional $921. This approach not only enhances your profit margins but also provides you with complete control over your sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling beats online involves several key components working in harmony. The COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack enables you to host your products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring free and reliable hosting. After a sale, your products are delivered automatically through backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Payment processing is seamlessly handled by NOWPayments, which verifies crypto transactions in real-time. This architecture ensures that you maintain sovereignty over your digital store, without the interference of third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment solutions are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you're a beat maker in Nigeria or a template designer in Venezuela, this setup empowers you to sell your work directly to your audience without the hurdles imposed by conventional platforms. By embracing crypto payments, you can tap into a global market, allowing customers anywhere to purchase your products without the need for a traditional banking system. This model not only democratizes access to digital commerce but also aligns with the needs of creators who prioritize autonomy.
Retain more profits by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of your online beat-selling venture hinges on multiple interrelated components. Start with an infrastructure stack like the Complete Builder Kit, which provides you with all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to launch your digital store. Each stack is built to facilitate hosting, product delivery, and payment processing, all while ensuring that you control your data and transactions. By integrating NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and benefit from extremely low transaction fees. The synergy between these tools creates a robust and scalable platform for your digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your beats online using this infrastructure, begin by selecting a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to manage crypto transactions seamlessly. Load your products into the system and configure your storefront using the templates provided in the Complete Builder Kit. Finally, promote your store to your audience, ensuring they know they can purchase your beats directly and securely using cryptocurrency.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, avoiding platform fees. By leveraging tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic, you can create a fully operational online store that maintains your ownership and control.
Enjoy full control over your digital products and customer data.

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without the burden of platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all the resources you need to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start your journey.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
